subject_identity: cohort + subject token; same S1 across centers conservatively merged
split: three fixed subject outer folds, each 6 train / 2 validation / 4 test subjects
selection: joint F1@0.5 then joint F1@0.3 then lower normal false alarm rate; smaller width and earlier epoch tie
reference_selection: training correct same exercise, different subject; healthy first, train median duration, one per subject
references: one for baseline; up to three for multi-reference method
gmm: Euclidean diagonal 4-component adaptation, not the authors' Riemannian GMM reproduction
supervision: presence, part, start/end boundary CE and interval regression; no clinical-normal label assigned outside principal interval
